scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Cone shaped red Santa hat is too ordinary.
It's old fashioned.
Maybe in 1980's?!
Haha~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
尖尖的紅色聖誕帽太普通了，早就過時啦。
難道還活在1980年代嗎？！
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
If you leave it on me,
I'll change it to lastest model.
You know what I mean~!
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
交給我，我就能把它改成最新款。
你懂的~！

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
You know Antonio's hat,right?
Guess who made it?
As you know, Antonio is hard to catch,
that's because I blowed some power in the hat.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
你知道安東尼奧的帽子吧？
猜猜是誰做的？
安東尼奧那麼難抓，就是因為我給那頂帽子注入了魔力。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
If you don't like your hat,
bring it to me.
I'll change it to brand new one.
Stylish Louise's hat.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
不喜歡現在的帽子，就拿來給我吧。
我給你換一頂全新的時尚路易絲款帽子。

scripts.text: Here.
scripts.translation: 給你

scripts.text: It's ok.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Nice choice!!
If I do it like this ...
and this and...
finally it'll turn into fantastic hat.
But before that,I need some materials to make with.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
好選擇！！
如果我這樣做...
再這樣，還有...
最後它會變成一頂絕妙的帽子。
不過在那之前，我需要一些材料。

scripts.text: What are the materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什麼材料？

scripts.text: So what? I don't want to know.
scripts.translation: 算了，我不想聽

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Well, nothing special.
Basically, you need Santa's hat of course.
and with a touch of my magical fingers,
it'll just turn into very special thing.
Well,just little bit prettier and
little bit more practical. Haha...
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
沒什麼特別的，首先當然得有一頂聖誕帽。
再經我這雙魔法巧手一改，它就會變得與眾不同。
嗯，就是更漂亮一點，也更實用一點，哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Anyway,to sum up,required materials are....
Basically ^0000FFSanta's Hat^000000 and
 ^0000FF 1 Cactus Needle ^000000 for sewing, 
^0000FF 10 Holy Water ^000000 for blessing, 
^0000FF 1 Rosary ^000000 for luckiness.
It's pretty enough to make Louise Hat.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
總之，需要的材料是...
^0000FF聖誕帽^000000
^0000FF1個仙人掌刺^000000，用來縫帽子。
^0000FF10個聖水^000000，用來施加祝福。
^0000FF1個念珠^000000，用來帶來好運。
這些就夠做一頂路易絲帽了。

scripts.text: Here you are.....
scripts.translation: 給你...

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Wow~~!! So fast!!
I like your style~.
Ok!! If everything is ready, no need to hesitate.
I'll show you what Designer Louise Kim's power is.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
哇~~！！這麼快！！
我就喜歡你這麼爽快的人~！
材料齊了就別猶豫，讓你見識一下設計師路易絲·金的實力！

scripts.text:
-She puts the hat in a bucket -
-filled with Holy Water.-
-She rapidly takes it out and starts mending the hat-
-humming a tune.-
scripts.translation:
-她把帽子浸入裝滿聖水的桶中。-
-接著迅速取出，一邊哼歌，一邊開始修補帽子。-

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
~With the number one designer, Louise Kim,~
~you are the most blessed soul.~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
~有首席設計師路易絲·金相伴，~
~你就是最受祝福的人。~

scripts.text:
-Immediately, she puts Rosary in an-
-unknown liquid and dissolves it.-
-And with a brush,-
-neatly coats the liquid on -
-a thread of the hat.-
scripts.translation:
-她立刻把念珠放進一種不明液體中溶解。-
-隨後用刷子把液體均勻地塗在帽子的線上。-

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
~With the number one designer, Louise Kim,~
~you are the luckiest soul.~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
~在首席設計師路易絲·金面前，~
~你是最幸運的靈魂。~

scripts.text:
-She starts sewing the hat with -
-a Cactus Needle and a thread.-
scripts.translation: -她開始用仙人掌刺和線縫製帽子。-

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
~This is called the Louise's miracle.~
~The most talented disigner,~
~L_O_U_I_S_E K_I_M~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
~這就是路易絲的奇蹟。~
~最有才華的設計師，~
~L_O_U_I_S_E K_I_M~

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Here!! All done~~
How do you like it?
Isn't it so wonderful?
Take it!! It's a gift.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
來！！大功告成~~
怎麼樣，是不是很棒？
拿著吧！！送給你。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
I should have called high price for it
but as you know it's Christmas!
It's a gift for you!
I won't charge anything.
Just tell many people how good it is.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
本來應該收你一大筆錢，不過現在可是聖誕節！
就當禮物送給你，不收費。
幫我多宣傳宣傳它有多好就行。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Wherever you go,
whatever you do,
never take off the hat.
You won't have a chance to buy it
no matter how much you pay.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
不管去哪裡、做什麼，都別摘下這頂帽子。
這可是花多少錢都買不到的。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Alright~Go ahead~
Go brag yourself!
~Who would be happier than~
~being with Louise.~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
好了~去吧~去炫耀一下！
~有路易絲相伴，~
~誰能比你更幸福？~

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Come on~If you just get me the materials,
I won't charge anything,
Call me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
來嘛~只要帶齊材料，我就不收費。
改變主意了就來找我。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
You'll regret!
Think again!
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
你會後悔的！
再想想吧！

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Ok~ whatever~
It's not me,
who's going to lose whose own luck.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]
好吧~隨便你~
反正錯過好運的人又不是我。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Perhaps you get the chance to acheive Santa's Hat later some time,
think about it carefully.
You can get the better designed hat,
and I can show off my talent.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 路易絲·金]

你能得到更漂亮的帽子，我也能展示自己的才華。

scripts.text:

It's already winter again~~!
This chilling weather makes
my body freeze~

Who said that christmas is only for lovers~

!!!!!!!!!!!!!

[Oholy]
Oh, my. You have a wonderful
voice!! Alright!!!
I was going to give these
to kids, but, since you found
my music book and sang a carol to me!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
哎呀，你的歌聲真美！！太好了！！！
這些本來是給孩子們準備的，不過你幫我找回樂譜，還為我唱了頌歌，就送給你吧！

scripts.text:
-She brought a big sack-
-and opened it in front of you-
scripts.translation: -她拿來一個大袋子，在你面前開啟。-

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
OK! Don't look inside.
Just put your hands
grab what you want.
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
好！不許往裡看。
伸手進去，摸到什麼就拿什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Cookie Bag!
I wrapped those indivisually.
There are many sweets in them.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
餅乾袋子！
這些是單獨包裝的。
裡面有很多糖果。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Candies!
These were made by
Chief noun.
Very sweet and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
糖果！
這是修女長做的，又甜又好吃。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Candy Canes!
These were made by
Chief noun.
Very sweet and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
柺杖糖！
這是修女長做的，又甜又好吃。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Piece Of Cake!
These were baked by
Chief Acolyte.
Very soft and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
小蛋糕！
這是服事長烤的，鬆軟又好吃。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Cookies!
These were baked by
Chief Acolyte.
Very crispy and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
餅乾！
這是服事長烤的，香脆又好吃。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Spore Doll!
It's made elaborately by
Bishop, Tomas.
Very cute.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
魔菇娃娃！
這是托馬主教精心製作的。
非常可愛。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Baphomet Doll!
..........?!..........
How did it get in here..?!
Oops, oh well.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
巴風特娃娃！
...？！...
怎麼會混進來...？！
啊，算了。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:

..........?!..........

Merry Christmas!

啊，算了。

scripts.text:

A Rocker Doll!
This was donated by
a knight, Lighten.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
搖滾蝗蟲娃娃！
這是騎士萊頓捐贈的，他真好心。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Yoyo Doll!
This was donated by
an assassin, Marzia.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
溜溜猴娃娃！
這是刺客馬爾齊亞捐贈的，他真好心。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Racoon Doll!
This was donated by
a hunter, Raiden Kurs.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
浣熊娃娃！
這是獵人雷登·庫爾斯捐贈的，他真好心。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Black Cat Doll!
Sister Magareta found the item
from the monster, Loli Ruri.
Very kind of her.
Hope she is doing okay.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
黑貓娃娃！
瑪格麗特修女從蘿莉·露莉身上
撿到了這個物品。
她真好心。
希望她一切都好。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Hung Doll!
I made this doll.
Isn't it adorable?!
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
吊頸娃娃！
這是我做的娃娃。
是不是很可愛？！
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Munak Doll!
That is from some country
across the ocean.
An artisan made this doll
with his passion.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
殭屍娃娃！
這是從大洋彼岸的某個國家帶來的，一位工匠傾注心血製作了它。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Santa Hat!
This is only produced
during Christmas season.
It is not a common hat.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
聖誕帽！
只有聖誕節期間才會製作，可不是普通的帽子。
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Welcome back!! You look good.
2 arms and 2 legs, you look great.
But, where is my music book?!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
歡迎回來！！看起來還不錯嘛。
兩隻胳膊兩條腿，都好好的。
可我的樂譜呢？！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Thank you very much.
People and even Devils are
all excited on Christmas day,
so nobody knows what would
happen. Will you help me
then, won't you? Please~
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
非常感謝。
聖誕節連惡魔都會和人們一樣興奮，誰也不知道會出什麼事。
要是有事，你還會幫我吧？拜託啦~

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Let's think about the neighbors
and do a good deed during Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奧霍利]
讓我們為鄰居著想，在聖誕節行善吧！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Heyhey, human!!
Don't ya wanna sell your
soul and be bound in a beneficial contract with me?
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
嘿嘿，人類！！
要不要出賣靈魂，跟我籤個划算的契約？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, you! Deviruchi!!!
What a brat!!! Gotcha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你！小惡魔！！！
真是個壞蛋！！！抓住了！

scripts.text:
-You quickly snatched-
-the nape of Deviruchi's neck-
scripts.translation: -你一把抓住小惡魔的後頸。-

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
What are you doing!?
Human?
Let go of me...right now!
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
人類，你幹什麼！？
放開我...馬上！

scripts.text:
-Deviruchi quickly ran away-
-^4d4dffWhere Deviruchi is gone,-
-there is a worn out paper.^000000-
-Let's read the paper.-
scripts.translation:
-小惡魔飛快地逃走了。-
-^4d4dff它離開的地方，留著一張破舊的紙。^000000-

Sledge... Reindeer...
Hmm, I think I got what I need.
Let's go back to Ms.Oholy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

雪橇...馴鹿...
嗯，這應該就是我要找的東西。
回去找奧霍利女士吧。
